---
name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaBio MVP slice for sequence expression or reproducible bioinformatics analysis with explicit scientific limits. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an approved pipeline or making clinical claims.
---

# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` planned capabilities and Beta criteria.
- Choose one small reproducible dataset and one computational question.
- Define input format output artifact and validation method.
- Separate computational output from laboratory or clinical interpretation.
- State unsupported organisms assays and analysis types.
- Require tests provenance and documented limitations before completion.
